insurer: Star Health and Allied Insurance Company Limited
sumInsured: 5,00,000 to 1,00,00,000 (as per tables in policy wording; exact SI depends on what you choose in schedule)

great.name: Restore Benefit
great.quote: There shall be automatic restoration of the Basic Sum Insured by 100% immediately upon exhaustion of the Basic Sum Insured and accrued Cumulative Bonus if any, once during the policy period. It is made clear that such restored Sum Insured can be utilized for the subsequent hospitalization even for the illness /disease for which claim/s was / were already made.
great.explanation: Automatically restores 100% of the Basic Sum Insured once in the policy year after the Basic Sum Insured (and any Cumulative Bonus) is exhausted. The restored amount can be used even for the same illness/disease in a later hospitalization, which improves protection against multiple admissions.

great.name: Bariatric Surgery
great.quote: Section 7 Bariatric Surgery Expenses incurred on hospitalization for bariatric surgical procedure and its complications thereof are payable subject to limits mentioned in the table given below
great.explanation: Hospitalization expenses for bariatric surgery and its complications are covered, subject to limits in the table. This is valuable because many plans exclude bariatric procedures or restrict them heavily.

good.name: Room Rent
good.quote: Room (Private Single A/C room), Boarding and Nursing Expenses as provided by the Hospital / Nursing Home
good.explanation: Covers room, boarding and nursing charges for a Private Single A/C room. This avoids low room-rent caps, but does not give “any room/at actuals” flexibility.

good.name: PED Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing Disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 36 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy with insurer
good.reference: Exclusions > Standard Exclusions > 1 (Pre-Existing Diseases - Code Excl 01)
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are covered only after 36 months of continuous coverage from the first policy inception. This is within the common 2–4 year range, so you need to plan for out-of-pocket costs during the waiting period.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the following listed Conditions, surgeries/ treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy with us.
good.reference: Exclusions > Standard Exclusions > 2 (Specified disease / procedure waiting period - Code Excl 02)
good.explanation: Listed diseases/procedures are not covered for the first 24 months of continuous coverage. Claims for these conditions during this period will be rejected even if they are not pre-existing.

good.name: Initial Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident
good.reference: Exclusions > Standard Exclusions > 3 (30-day waiting period - Code Excl 03)
good.explanation: Illness-related claims are not covered in the first 30 days from policy start, except for accidents. This is a standard waiting period, so early non-accident medical costs won’t be payable.

good.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: Relevant Pre-Hospitalization medical expenses incurred for a period not exceeding 60 days prior to the date of hospitalization are payable subject to an admissible hospitalization claim
good.explanation: Covers relevant medical expenses up to 60 days before hospitalization, as long as the hospitalization claim is admissible. This helps pay for consultations, tests and medicines leading up to admission.

good.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: Post Hospitalization: Medical expenses incurred for a period up to 90 days from the date of discharge from the hospital ... are payable
good.explanation: Covers medical expenses up to 90 days after discharge, subject to policy terms. Follow-up treatment beyond 90 days will not be covered under post-hospitalization.

bad.name: Modern Treatments
bad.quote: Section 13 - Coverage for Modern Treatments The expenses payable ... is limited to the amount mentioned in table below;
bad.explanation: Modern treatments are covered but subject to sub-limits as per the table. This can leave significant out-of-pocket costs if an advanced procedure costs more than the capped amount.

bad.name: NCB
bad.quote: In the event of a claim resulting in ... the cumulative bonus so granted will be reduced ... At any point of time, the cumulative bonus will not be less than “zero”
bad.reference: Conditions > Special Features > 29(b) Special Conditions for Cumulative Bonus
bad.explanation: Cumulative Bonus is reduced when a claim occurs and can go down to zero. This means your increased cover from past claim-free years can be lost after claims.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: This policy is subject to co-payment of 10% of each and every claim amount for fresh as well as renewal policies for insured persons whose age at the time of entry is 61 years and above.. This co-payment will not apply for those insured persons who have entered the policy before attaining 61 years of age and renew the policy continuously without any break.
bad.explanation: A 10% co-payment applies on each and every claim if the insured’s entry age is 61 years or above. This directly increases your share of every admissible claim, reducing the insurer payout.
